title: 5Paisa Refer and Earn Demat with GroMo in 2026
summary: 5Paisa refer and earn through GroMo: cash commission per activated demat account, today's price, your link, limits and the terms that decide payouts. Not the official 5Paisa program.
body_markdown:
5Paisa refer and earn through GroMo works differently from the broker's own scheme: GroMo is a distribution partner platform where you earn a cash commission, typically Rs 100 to 400, for every 5Paisa demat account that gets activated through your link, paid straight to your bank, with no monthly cap and no need to hold a 5Paisa account yourself. This guide covers the GroMo route in full: today's price, getting your link, the limit question, the terms that actually decide payouts, and who to refer.


To be clear from the first line: this is the GroMo partner way, a separate program from 5Paisa's official refer and earn, whose live offer you should always check in the 5Paisa app itself.


## 5Paisa refer and earn via GroMo: quick facts


Question Quick answer


What you earn Cash commission per activated 5Paisa demat account, typically Rs 100 to 400


Where the rate shows On the 5Paisa product card inside the GroMo app, per live campaign


Monthly limit None on the GroMo route


Own 5Paisa account needed? No, one free GroMo KYC covers everything


Cost Rs 0 to join, train, and share


Payment trigger Account activated and verified, not just the form filled


## 5Paisa refer and earn today price: how to check it


There is no fixed public rate, and that is true of both routes. On GroMo, the commission is set per campaign by the partner and displayed on the 5Paisa product card, open the demat section of the app and today's price is the number on the card. Rates move with campaigns, sometimes month to month, so screenshot-quoting sites are stale by definition.


The working habit of serious partners: check the card before each sharing push, because campaign bumps are the best weeks to refer. For 5Paisa's official program price, the only source is the 5Paisa app's refer section.


## How to get your 5Paisa refer and earn link on GroMo


1. **Download GroMo and complete KYC** with PAN, Aadhaar, and your bank details. It is free and takes minutes.
2. **Open the demat category** and find the 5Paisa card when its campaign is live, availability varies by partner campaign.
3. **Check today's rate** on the card, that is your per-activation commission.
4. **Share your unique link** on WhatsApp or in person with someone genuinely interested in investing.
5. **Track the application** in the app, commission credits to your bank after the account activates.


No 5Paisa login, no customer-first requirement, and the same KYC unlocks every other product in the catalogue.


## Is 5Paisa refer and earn free?


Completely, on both sides. GroMo charges nothing to join or share, your contact pays nothing to open the demat account, and 5Paisa account opening is digital with video KYC. Treat any site or person charging a fee to unlock 5Paisa referrals as a scam, the legitimate versions of this are free everywhere.


## 5Paisa refer and earn limit: is there one?


On the GroMo route, no. Distribution platforms exist to acquire customers at volume, so there is no 10-a-month style ceiling, your limit is how many genuine investors you can find and help through activation. Broker-run referral schemes, by contrast, usually cap monthly rewards, the pattern across brokers is mapped in[demat account refer and earn](https://gromo.in/blog/demat-account-refer-and-earn/) , and it is the single biggest structural difference between the two routes, the same split we detail for[Upstox refer and earn](https://gromo.in/blog/upstox-refer-and-earn/) .


## 5Paisa refer and earn terms and conditions that matter on GroMo


The GroMo route has its own compact rulebook, and every failed payout traces to one of these:


- **Activation is the trigger.** Commission pays when the demat and trading account is fully opened and verified, a half-finished application earns nothing.
- **New customer only.** Someone who already holds a 5Paisa account cannot generate a commission, offer them a different broker from the catalogue instead.
- **Complete KYC properly.** Wrong PAN details and abandoned video KYC are the two biggest killers, walk your contact through it on the spot.
- **Rates lock per campaign.** The rate on the card when the application goes through is what applies, check it in the app rather than relying on old screenshots.


For the official 5Paisa program's terms, payout dates, reward types, and caps, the 5Paisa app and website are the only authoritative source.


## What can you realistically earn?


At typical campaign rates, five activated accounts a month is Rs 500 to 2,000, and because there is no cap, the number scales with your network instead of stopping at a scheme limit. The real growth move is stacking: the same contact who opens a demat account may later need a credit card,[savings account](https://gromo.in/blog/saving-account-refer-and-earn/) , or loan, each paying its own commission on GroMo, which is how demat referrals become the entry point to a fuller income, as the[sell financial products and earn money](https://gromo.in/blog/sell-financial-products-and-earn-money/) playbook lays out. The cross-category earning map sits in[high paying refer and earn apps](https://gromo.in/blog/high-paying-refer-and-earn-apps/) and[refer and earn apps in India](https://gromo.in/blog/refer-and-earn-apps-in-india/) .


## Refer genuine people, it is the whole model


Commission pays on activation, and activation only happens when the person actually wants the account. Sharing links with strangers produces abandoned KYCs and zero income, while helping one genuinely investing-curious friend through the process produces a commission and, usually, their referrals next.


The honest pitch works best: a demat account is for investing, opening is free, video KYC takes minutes, and you are there to help with the steps. People who feel pushed abandon at KYC, people who feel helped complete, that conversion difference is your entire income in this business.

## FAQ: 5Paisa refer and earn


**1. What is the 5Paisa refer and earn today price?**
There is no fixed public price. On the GroMo route, today's rate appears on the 5Paisa product card in the app, typically in the Rs 100 to 400 per activation band. For the official 5Paisa program, the live offer shows in the 5Paisa app's refer section.


**2. How do I get a 5Paisa refer and earn link for free?**
Through GroMo: free KYC, open the demat category, and share the 5Paisa card's link when the campaign is live. Through the official route: the refer section inside your own 5Paisa app. Both are free, paying anyone for access is a scam marker.


**3. Is there a 5Paisa refer and earn limit?**
Not on the GroMo route, commissions scale without a monthly cap. Broker-run schemes typically do cap monthly rewards, check the 5Paisa app for the official program's current limit.


**4. When does the commission actually get paid?**
After the referred account is activated and verified, commission credits to your registered bank account, with per-application status visible in the GroMo app. Nothing pays on form-fill alone.


**5. Do I need my own 5Paisa account to refer?**
Not on GroMo, one free GroMo KYC lets you refer 5Paisa and other brokers without holding any of those accounts. The official broker scheme requires you to be an existing 5Paisa user.


**6. Is this the official 5Paisa referral program?**
No. GroMo is a separate distribution partner platform with its own rates, rules, and payouts. The official 5Paisa refer and earn is run by 5Paisa inside its own app, and its terms are published there.


**7. Why did my 5Paisa referral not pay?**
Almost always one of four: the contact abandoned video KYC, their details failed verification, they were already a 5Paisa customer, or the application ran outside your link. Track each application's status in the app and help contacts finish KYC on the spot.


**8. Which pays more, the official program or GroMo?**
It depends on live campaigns on both sides, so compare the 5Paisa app's current offer against the GroMo card the week you share. Structurally, GroMo wins on cash payout, no cap, and no own-account requirement, the official route wins when its campaign rate spikes above the distribution rate.
